sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
A Dragonrot Recovery Charm created by Emma.
With this charm, once can offer a "Dragon's Blood Droplet" at a Sculptor's Idol to restore all afflicted with Dragonrot back to health.
The charm contains a Dragonrot victim's blood, which Emma managed to purify and solidify into a bloodstone.
Given by Emma after acquiring a Dragonrot Blood Sample from one infected with Dragonrot.
Allows the use of Dragon's Blood Droplets to cure Dragonrot at the Sculptor's Idol.
